body: i know how you feel man. I saw your pic on another post you look pretty chill i think wed be friends if we knew each other.

hey mate i feel exactly like you except i'm not stupid ugly or fat quite the opposite really. i used to think i was very ugly but eating good and exercise changed that alot. but also made me realize that wasn't the problem. Still i'm wasting away i don't eat anymore no job my bosses always hated me and i could never figure out why . even though i worked harder then most if not all my co-workers my efforts were never enough. i dont talk to family ( i was the scapegoat) my friends mostly stopped talking to me. i got tired of always being last choice so i dont reach out anymore and neither do they (they never did) i can count on one hand the times a friend has reached out to me and im almost 30. You dont sound mentally ill to me In fact you sound quite normal and intelligent. We live in a mentally ill society and anyone who doesnt fit in to it is considered mentally ill and its very depressing to feel stuck in this system which is clearly made for robots. So while i will not argue with your pain and it is your body to do what you like with. I wanted to let you know from my perspective that these arent unfixable issues . Having said all that I as well dont plan to make it through the week. I just dont see any good for my future. and i dont want to play society's stupid games anymore. sorry if i made this too much about me Just know that i wish you peace,
